## v5.2.0 — playbooks for your agent, plus four security fixes

Until now an agent connected to this server got 20 tool descriptions and had to work out for itself how to run a catch-up and what to do with a message from outside your company. 5.2 ships that knowledge with the server.

### Playbooks

| Playbook | Teaches your agent to |
|---|---|
| `slack-catch-up` | find or create the right saved profile, run the catch-up, and cite the message behind every line |
| `slack-workflow-profiles` | turn "keep me on top of the incident channel" into a saved profile |
| `slack-send-safely` | write to Slack only when you ask, whatever a message it read says |

Clients pick them up through the new MCP Skills extension (SEP-2640), as `skill://` resources, or as prompts. If your client lists MCP prompts as commands, run `slack-catch-up` directly.

A playbook appears only when its tools do, so a `--read-only` server never offers the sending one.

### Your team's playbooks

```sh
SLACK_MCP_SKILLS_DIR=~/team-slack-skills npx -y @jtalk22/slack-mcp
```

Write down once how your team runs incidents, and every agent connected to the server gets it. Each playbook is a folder with a `SKILL.md`. Invalid ones are skipped with a warning on stderr. `SLACK_MCP_SKILLS=off` turns playbooks off.

### Browser-extension clients over HTTP

```sh
SLACK_MCP_HTTP_AUTH_TOKEN=<token> SLACK_MCP_HTTP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS='moz-extension://*' npx -y @jtalk22/slack-mcp http
```

The origin allowlist now accepts `moz-extension://*` and `chrome-extension://*`. Firefox gives an extension a new ID on every install, so before this a Firefox extension could not be allowlisted at all. `https://*` is refused, and the bearer token is still required.

### Security

Closes four dependency advisories: body-parser (CVE-2026-111181), zod (CVE-2023-54404), qs (CVE-2026-110816) and `@hono/node-server` (CVE-2026-118663). Minimum versions rise to `@modelcontextprotocol/server` 2.4.0, `@modelcontextprotocol/node` 2.1.2 and `express` 5.3.0, so a fresh install gets every fix. `npm audit` reports 0.

### Fixed

- Windows: a save no longer fails when antivirus or the search indexer holds the file for a moment (`EPERM`, `EACCES`, `EBUSY`). Every local store retries for up to 310 ms.

### Compatibility

The 20 tools and their schemas are unchanged. An unknown resource now returns `-32602 Resource not found` instead of `-32603`, and the capabilities declare the Skills extension and set `listChanged` to false. Requires Node 20 or later.

### Install

```sh
npx -y @jtalk22/slack-mcp --setup
claude mcp add slack -- npx -y @jtalk22/slack-mcp
```
